RCSP-166.description: Validate Notes field availability, persistence, Order History visibility, multiline handling, and max-length validation across Scheduled Orders and Hot Shot Order

testCases.testName: Verify that the Notes text field is available on the Create New Scheduled Order page
testCases.description: Validate that the Notes field is visible and editable on the New Scheduled Order screen.

testCases.testName: Verify that the Notes text field is available on the Hot Shot Order page
testCases.description: Validate that the Notes field is visible and editable on the Hot Shot Order screen.

testCases.testName: Verify Notes entered on Create New Scheduled Order are saved successfully after clicking Save as Draft
testCases.description: Create a Scheduled Order draft, reopen it from the grid, and verify the Notes value persists exactly.

testData.notes: Need urgent approval from regional manager.

testCases.testName: Verify that user can update Notes for a Draft Scheduled Order from the Scheduled Orders result grid
testCases.description: Create a Scheduled Order draft, update its Notes value, and verify the new value persists after reopening the draft.

testData.updatedNotes: Deliver before noon and notify store manager.

testCases.testName: Verify that user is restricted from editing Notes after Scheduled Order is created using Create and Submit
testCases.description: Create and submit a Scheduled Order, then verify Notes cannot be edited or the edit path is unavailable for the submitted order.

testCases.testName: Verify that Notes entered on Hot Shot Order page are saved successfully after clicking Create and Submit
testCases.description: Create and submit a Hot Shot order, then open its details and verify the Notes value persists exactly.

testCases.testName: Verify that Notes entered while saving Scheduled Order as Draft are visible correctly in Order History
testCases.description: Create a Scheduled Order draft, open it from Order History, and verify the Notes value matches exactly.

testCases.testName: Verify that Notes entered for Submitted Scheduled Order are visible correctly in Order History after submission
testCases.description: Create a Scheduled Order draft, submit it from the grid, then verify the submitted order shows the exact Notes value in Order History.

testCases.testName: Verify that Notes entered while creating Hot Shot Order are visible correctly in Order History
testCases.description: Create and submit a Hot Shot order, then verify the same Notes value in Order History.

testCases.testName: Verify that Notes field on Scheduled Order creation page accepts special characters, multiline text, and numeric values
testCases.description: Create a Scheduled Order draft with multiline Notes containing special characters and verify the value is retained exactly after reopening the draft.

testCases.testName: Verify system validates maximum allowed character limit for Notes field on Scheduled Order creation page
testCases.description: Enter an overlong Notes value and verify the application restricts characters, prevents save, or surfaces a validation state.
